title: jmap-server push: opt-in conditional PushSubscription/set
description:
Design: docs/design/conditional.md. Decisions: docs/design/DECISIONS.md.
Note key: C5. Crates: jmap-server (push.rs, tests). Size: S.

Implement the PushSubscription part of docs/design/conditional.md §5.1 and §9 emailpush paragraph (conditional-02 §2.1, §9.1; RFC 8620 §7.2.2). Decision 1 (docs/design/DECISIONS.md): add register_push_subscription_conditional<B: PushSubscriptionBackend + ConditionalBackend>(dispatcher, backend) attaching SetSupport for PushSubscription/set; register_push_subscription_handlers is unchanged. SetScopeRequest.account_id = None (scope keyed by credentials). Lands after the emailpush push.rs seam (emailpush bead 1). Acceptance: mock-backend tests (serialized_writes_scope): precondition on keys or url -> forbidden (PushSubscription/get already forbids them); ifInState still ignored (no /get state); a precondition on a readable property passes and fails as specified; conditional_ready() true with push + probe registered and opted in; public-api additions only.
